title: Splicing a signed closed row into the augmented finite-subset row
statement: Let i:Z→X be a scheme morphism, F a SignedClosedFamily inside Z, and A a commutative ring sheaf on X_proet. Given any SignedClosedRow S of [lem-sfb-closed-restriction-signed-refinements], there exists a Row i F.members A in the precise sense of [def-sfb-closed-intersection-augmented-row]. Its empty term is the support object in degree -1. No exactness, locality, comparison, or contraction is asserted.

source.place: Tags 09AA, 09BM, 09AH; agent deduction in lem-sfb-closed-intersection-vertex-contraction, proof step 2 (signed row and augmentation, including reindexing by finite subsets)

proof.text: Use the given row in nonnegative degrees, its support object E_Z in degree -1, and zero below -1. The map from degree -1 to zero is its given augmentation; all other differentials are the given ones or zero. The chain-map equation for alpha says that augmentation followed by d from zero to one is zero. The other squares vanish by the row's differential-square equation or because an object is zero. Apply this construction to morphisms using the given natural augmentation; this defines an additive functor. The empty subset is the unique subset of augmented degree -1, so its product is canonically E_Z. In nonnegative degree p, send an increasing (p+1)-tuple to its image subset. Its inverse lists a subset in increasing order. These are inverse bijections and induce the required product isomorphisms. Outside the finite range both indexing types are empty and both terms are zero. For nonempty source and target indices use the given restriction when the source is contained in the target, and zero otherwise. For the empty source and nonempty target use fromSupport; for two empty indices use the identity. A nonempty source and empty target has zero map. The unit equations follow respectively from restriction_unit, fromSupport_unit and the identity equation. The matrix formula in nonnegative degrees is the original differential formula under the bijection: the number of vertices smaller than the deleted vertex is its position. At the augmentation it is exactly augment_components and the sign is one. In all other degrees the source or target product is zero. Thus all fields of Row hold, naturally in the module, with precisely the prescribed units and signs.
